svg.title: What I build and what I enjoy
svg.desc: Left: a developer window showing AI Engineering, Machine Learning and Software Engineering. Right: a looping carousel of hobbies — coding, AI, building projects, learning — with decorative Build, Learn and Ship rings.

g.text: Turning ideas into clean, working Python.
LLMs, RAG and agents that do real work.
End-to-end apps, shipped — not just notebooks.
Trying new tools and keeping what works.
